_comment: Every risk number Theta Gate enforces, in one place. Rendered verbatim in the Streamlit dashboard next to the line 'no LLM can write to this file'. No LLM does — brain.py never imports json.dump against this path.

strategy._dte_comment: PK decision, 1 Sep 2026 -- the tenor half of PR #27, taken; its sizing half rejected. 6-9 -> 3-5. THE BINDING CONSTRAINT WAS TENOR, NOT SIZE (msuiche's finding, and it is right): everything is force-closed Thu 3 Sep, so a 9-DTE spread entered Tuesday is held two sessions of a nine-day life and hands back most of its credit unearned. Measured on the live position, not modelled: $0.61 -> $0.49 in one session. At 3-5 DTE the same delta and the same defined risk capture far more of that credit before the flatten. The canonical plan's 6-9 argument was about avoiding the 2-DTE time exit in a normal week; a hard Thursday flatten inverts it. Never 0DTE -- no greeks, so the delta rule has no input. KNOWN INTERACTION, left to the gate on purpose: at fixed delta premium falls with sqrt(T), so a 3-5 DTE credit may not clear min_credit_pct_of_width (0.10 = $0.50 on a $5 spread). If it does not, gate_credit_floor vetoes and the agent declines. Declining is the safe failure, so the floor was NOT relaxed to make room for this change.
strategy._credit_quality_comment: Verified live 26 Aug 2026: credit/width is NOT a fixed 0.20-0.45 band. It tracks ~0.8 x short_delta and falls as width increases (5-wide 0.120 -> 25-wide 0.056). This gate catches a bad quote relative to that curve, not an absolute ratio.
strategy._min_credit_comment: Fable 5 strategy review, 28 Aug 2026: an absolute floor, separate from the relative credit_quality check above. At the low end of the delta band (0.16) with the relative check's own -40% tolerance, credit can fall to ~$0.38 on a $5 spread and still pass the relative test -- too thin to be worth the mechanical and execution risk. This gate catches that case.
strategy._fixed_quantity_comment: PK decision, 30-31 Aug 2026 (X1, ANALYSIS-2026-08-30 rank 16): 1 -> 2, amending canonical plan Sec 2.12. Landed with partial-fill handling across every order path -- at qty 2 a partial fill is possible and the ladder treats it as THE position (no top-up, no unwind). Max loss ~$880 per position at credit 0.60, inside every cap. Disclosed honestly: this is 4x variance, not 4x edge.

entry._deadline_comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.3, 29 Aug 2026: Wednesday is morning-only (the afternoon window is dropped — a spread needs enough runway before Thursday's flatten to cover its own bid-ask round trip). This value previously read 16:00, which wrongly left the Wednesday afternoon window open. Sep 4 is NFP day, 08:30 ET, verified against bls.gov this session (data/events_2026-08-31_2026-09-04.json) and falls after Thursday's flatten, so it does not block any entry.

exit._stop_comment: Renamed from stop_loss_multiple_of_credit (canonical plan Sec 2.1, 29 Aug 2026): the multiple applies to the CLOSING DEBIT, not the loss. At credit=$0.60, this multiple gives a $1.20 closing debit and a $0.60 loss (1x credit), not a $1.20 loss. exit_signal()'s arithmetic was already correct — only the name was misleading.
exit._time_exit_comment: 2 -> 1, 1 Sep 2026, with the 3-5 DTE band. At 3-5 DTE a time exit at 2 fires the day after entry and gives back the decay the tenor change exists to capture. Thursday's force-close ladder is the real exit now; the time exit is a backstop for a position that somehow outlives it.
exit._force_close_comment: Canonical plan Sec 8.2, 29 Aug 2026: ladder moved 30 min earlier across the board. The old ladder's forceful rung landed at 15:50, ten minutes before the 16:00 close, with no recovery time if it failed.

risk._max_concurrent_comment: Canonical plan, 29 Aug 2026: 3 -> 2. SPY and QQQ are one correlated bucket. With width fixed at $5 and quantity fixed at 2 (X1, 31 Aug), this caps total margin reserve at $2,000 arithmetically -- no separate dollar-reserve gate needed.
risk._daily_fill_cap_comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.5, 29 Aug 2026: a morning fill blocks an afternoon re-entry in the same underlying even if that morning spread already closed.

regime._comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.6, 29 Aug 2026: entry-only regime filters, sourced from Cboe's public VIX-family CSVs. Never blocks exits or liquidates an open position -- a spike blocks NEW entries only.

vrp._comment: The only edge this strategy claims. Verified live: a fairly priced chain has zero arithmetic edge, negative by exactly the bid-ask cost. Sell premium only when it is actually rich.
vrp._lookback_comment: PK decision, 30 Aug 2026 (option C in docs/ANALYSIS-2026-08-30.md): 20 -> 10 so the realised-vol window matches the 6-9 DTE tenor being sold. The 30 Aug audit found the gate comparing the front of a contango vol curve against a 20-day RV still carrying the 3-4 Aug rally days: on Friday's marks it vetoed every SPY and QQQ candidate for Mon-Tue (SPY IV 9.9-10.1% vs RV20 10.4%; QQQ 14.8-15.2% vs 18.2%). At 10 days: SPY +2.1..+2.3 pts, QQQ +1.3..+1.7.
vrp._min_vrp_points_comment: Canonical plan Sec 4.6, 29 Aug 2026: tightened from a plain IV>=RV check to a 2.0-vol-point margin -- IV barely above RV is noise, not a priced premium. 30 Aug 2026 (PK, option C): re-based to 1.0 together with the 10-day window above; the 2.0 cushion was sized against a 20-day RV. Chosen with Friday's data in view -- disclosed as such in the write-up.

environment._paper_flag_comment: Case-insensitive membership test only. Never a truthiness cast. Any value outside this set selects live, including 'paper', 'TRUE ' with a trailing space, and 'yes!'.

operational._assignment_flatten_comment: PK decision, 31 Aug 2026: an overnight assignment is now flattened autonomously by an explicit single-symbol limit order rather than HALTing for a human. The limit crosses the touch by this fraction so it is marketable without chasing a broken book. Still never close_position or close-all — those need a human yes regardless of confirmation_mode.
operational._no_bulk_comment: cancel_all_orders, close_all_positions, close_position, exercise_options_position and do_not_exercise_options_position all require explicit human confirmation on Alpaca's own paper-trading skills, regardless of confirmation_mode. Theta Gate never calls any of them. Every close is an explicit order naming both legs.
